بالتعاون مع الجمعية الوطنية للعمل التطوع: In collaboration with the National Association for Voluntary Work
Ooredoo تُقدم دعمها للمتضررين من الحرائق: Ooredoo provides support to those affected by the fires in the wilaya of Jijel
على إثر الحرائق الأخيرة التي مست عدداً م: Following the recent fires that affected several regions of the country, particularly the wilaya of Jijel, Ooredoo Algeria, in collaboration with the National Association for Voluntary Work (ANV), organized a solidarity operation on Tuesday, September 1, 2026, in the wilaya of Jijel, aimed at providing support and assistance to the affected population and families impacted by these fires.
في إطار التزامها المواطن وتعبئتها المتوا: As part of its civic commitment and continuous mobilization to stand by the populations affected by the fires, Ooredoo Algeria, in collaboration with the National Association for Voluntary Work, launched a solidarity convoy consisting mainly of electric generators and priority basic necessities to respond to emergency situations.
أشرف على هذه القافلة التضامنية كلٌّ من ر: This solidarity convoy was overseen by the President of the National Association for Voluntary Work, Mr. Ahmed Mellah, and the Director of Corporate Affairs, Media Relations, and Corporate Social Responsibility at Ooredoo, Mr. Ramdane Djazairi, in a scene that embodies the depth of the partnership and the commitment of both parties to pool their efforts and mobilize their resources to provide a concrete response to the actual needs of the families affected by the fires.
في مرحلة أولى، تم إيداع المساعدات الإنسا: In the first phase, the humanitarian aid was deposited at a warehouse dedicated to collecting donations in the municipality of El Aouana, to be subsequently delivered and distributed to the affected population according to needs identified in the field.
في ذات السياق، تنقل بعد ذلك متطوعو مؤسسة: In the same context, Ooredoo volunteers and the National Association for Voluntary Work then traveled to the heights of the municipality of El Aouana, in the villages affected by the recent fires, to stand by the population on the ground. This solidarity initiative included the distribution of electric generators to the affected families, contributing to alleviating the impact of the exceptional situation imposed by the fires on their daily lives.
بهذه المناسبة، صرّح المدير العام لـ Oore: On this occasion, the General Manager of Ooredoo Algeria, Mr. Rony Tomeh, stated: "In light of the recent fires that have affected several regions of the country, Ooredoo Algeria expresses its deep solidarity with the families affected by this tragedy. Through this solidarity operation, we wish to tangibly embody our will to contribute to alleviating the difficulties faced by the affected families. This initiative adds to the operation launched by Ooredoo by providing free calls and internet for 7 days to its customers in the affected wilayas, reflecting our responsibility as a corporate citizen and our commitment to stand by the children of this country and provide support and assistance, especially during these difficult circumstances."
من جهته، أشاد رئيس الجمعية الوطنية للعمل: For his part, the President of the National Association for Voluntary Work, Mr. Ahmed Mellah, praised this initiative, saying: "We value this solidarity initiative launched by Ooredoo Algeria, which practically embodies the importance of collective mobilization in facing emergency situations. The provision of electric generators and basic materials responds to real needs identified in the field and will contribute to supporting the affected families. We extend our thanks to Ooredoo Algeria for its trust and civic commitment, and we renew our will to continue our efforts, serve the community, and contribute to consolidating the values of national solidarity."
تندرج هذه المبادرة في صميم نهج المسؤولية: This initiative is at the core of Ooredoo Algeria's corporate social responsibility approach, and within the framework of its continuous commitment to the values of solidarity, mutual aid, and supporting the population, especially in emergencies and crises.
يأتي هذا الالتزام امتداداً لمبادرات تضام: This commitment is an extension of solidarity initiatives previously launched by Ooredoo Algeria for the benefit of populations affected by fires, as the company notably provided support during the fires that affected the wilayas of El Tarf and Souk Ahras in 2022, as well as the 2023 fires, in solidarity with the populations who faced the aftermath of these disasters.
من خلال هذا الزخم التضامني الوطني، تجدد: Through this wave of national solidarity, Ooredoo Algeria renews its steadfast commitment to Algerian society, affirming its unconditional support for those affected by the recent fires and its continued contribution to solidarity and support efforts for citizens in various circumstances.
